name: Art Nouveau · Forest with a Gold-Leaf Effect

features.label: Elongated forms
features.explanation: Simplify existing forms into elongated, coherent decorative silhouettes
features.evidence: Slender trunks and spreading branches form continuous curves; the swirling patterns on the path echo the rhythms of the tree crowns.
features.zh: 将原有形体概括为修长、完整的装饰性剪影
features.en: Simplify existing forms into elongated, coherent decorative silhouettes

features.label: Continuous curves
features.explanation: Describe existing forms with flowing curves and fine lines, adding fine gold lines in selected areas
features.evidence: Slender trunks and spreading branches form continuous curves; the swirling patterns on the path echo the rhythms of the tree crowns.
features.zh: 用流动曲线与细线刻画原有形体，局部加入细金线
features.en: Describe existing forms with flowing curves and fine lines, adding fine gold lines in selected areas

features.label: Deep blue and golden ochre
features.explanation: Set golden ochre and pale gold against deep blue and near-black, with small vermilion accents as focal points
features.evidence: Deep blue and near-black establish the background, golden ochre and pale gold cover the branches and foliage, and small amounts of vermilion create local focal points.
features.zh: 以深蓝近黑承托金赭与浅金，少量朱红作为焦点
features.en: Set golden ochre and pale gold against deep blue and near-black, with small vermilion accents as focal points

features.label: Matte luminosity
features.explanation: Reduce realistic reflections and render gold as matte color fields
features.evidence: Matte ornament with a gold-leaf-like appearance, fine outlines and repeated leaves give the image the look of a tapestry or decorative mural.
features.zh: 弱化写实反光，让金色以哑光色面呈现
features.en: Reduce realistic reflections and render gold as matte color fields

features.label: Vertical rhythm
features.explanation: Keep the original composition and link existing forms through continuous directional rhythms
features.evidence: Tall trunks form a vertical framework; an S-shaped path extends from the foreground, allowing botanical pattern and spatial depth to coexist.
features.zh: 保留原构图，以连续的方向节奏串联现有形体
features.en: Keep the original composition and link existing forms through continuous directional rhythms

features.label: Fine patterns
features.explanation: Organize fine repeated patterns within existing forms, varying their density
features.evidence: Matte ornament with a gold-leaf-like appearance, fine outlines and repeated leaves give the image the look of a tapestry or decorative mural.
features.zh: 在原有形体内组织细密而有疏密的重复纹样
features.en: Organize fine repeated patterns within existing forms, varying their density

features.label: Quiet fairy-tale mood
features.explanation: Create a quiet, mysterious and decorative fairy-tale atmosphere
features.evidence: Small animals and red mushrooms in the nighttime forest evoke a folktale; these subjects do not need to be added to the original photograph when transferring the style.
features.zh: 营造幽静、神秘而有装饰性的童话氛围
features.en: Create a quiet, mysterious and decorative fairy-tale atmosphere

features.label: Keep the original palette
features.explanation: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast.
features.evidence: This is an optional creative variation, not a description of the reference artwork.
features.zh: 保留原图的主要色相关系，只调整色阶与对比
features.en: Keep the source image’s main hue relationships, adjusting only tonal values and contrast

avoid.zh: 不新增原图没有的人物、建筑、动物或道具；不复制参考图题字与水印；避免细节密度平均、材质噪声过重
avoid.en: Do not add people, buildings, animals or props absent from the source; do not copy reference lettering or watermarks; avoid uniform detail density and excessive texture noise
